A '''Porax-38 starfighter''' was [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by the [[Utapau Skyforce]] [[Air Commodore/Legends|Air Commodore]] [[Senin Vant/Legends|Senin Vant]]. At some point prior to the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle of Utapau]]<ref name="ICS" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] was taken for an [[Deflector shield/Legends|unshielded]] joyride, during which a [[Utapaun flying squid/Legends|Utapaun flying squid]] collided with the fighter near its [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]], leaving a dent and a smear. Vant later flew the Porax-38 starfighter during the Battle of Utapau against the forces of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="ICS" />
